paragraphs: quiet week in stockholm, heads-down on cursor tooling. been iterating on shipflow and cursor-commands, exploring how AI agents can make building software feel more like flow state than friction. contributed a PR, pushed some commits, but mostly just deep in the code.

listening to a mix of dream pop and trip hop while coding — beach house, tame impala, massive attack. the overcast skies match the vibe. been exploring french indie pop too, which feels like discovering a new pattern in the codebase. everything connects.
